name: Notification Center
author: Eshayat Al-Wasiu
description: Omapager notifications with a persistent notification center

barWidget.description: Opens a panel listing all notifications

schema.label: Live notifications stack
schema.description: all = one deck in the corner, same-source notifications grouped inside it; source = a separate deck per source, each expanding on its own.

schema.label: Notification buttons
schema.description: Which end of a card its action buttons sit at.

schema.label: Hide the browser's Settings button
schema.description: Chrome puts a Settings action on every web notification. It is the same button on every card and it crowds out the ones that are worth pressing.

schema.label: Snooze lengths
schema.description: What the snooze menus offer, on a card and in the panel. A desktop where half an hour is the useful unit and one where half a day is are both real.

schema.label: Tomorrow morning starts at
schema.description: The hour "until tomorrow" wakes a source at, on a 24-hour clock.

schema.label: Let verification codes through
schema.description: A snooze or a silence holds everything back except a notification carrying a verification code. You asked for that code thirty seconds ago and it expires in five minutes, so "I'll look later" does not apply to it.

schema.label: Raise the window a site is open in
schema.description: Match a notification's site against browser window titles, so a Slack notification lands in the browser already showing Slack rather than opening a new tab. Off, only a window whose class carries the site is raised.
